# Scripture Atlas

> A single-page digital-humanities dashboard by Curtis Hoffmann for the visual literary analysis of the King James Bible, the Book of Mormon and the Pearl of Great Price. Distant reading (character network, cross-reference web, parallel chronology) beside close reading (commentary, careful character disambiguation, and the complete 38,341-verse text of all 86 books).

Site: https://curtishoffmann.com/scripture/
Source: https://github.com/phagehunter/scripture

## Views

- Character Network: 192 curated figures and collectives across four volumes, force-directed; node size by degree centrality, color by role group; eight typed edge classes (family, succession, teaching, conflict, alliance, divine encounter, vision, quotation). Homonyms carry subscript numbers (Alma₁/Alma₂, Nephi₁–₃, Moroni₁/₂).
- Cross-References: 7,052 verse pairs, 519 from verse-aligned quotation blocks (Isaiah, Malachi and Matthew quoted in the Book of Mormon) and 6,533 from the dataset's Bible / Book of Mormon reference listing (mechanical, generous, labeled as such); aggregated into 532 book-to-book arcs; 63 annotated highlights with commentary; references shown verse by verse in the reader; any pair opens side by side in the Compare tab.
- Parallel Chronology: Old World and New World on one piecewise, zoomable time axis, from the patriarchs and the Jaredites to the Restoration era.
- Text tab: full reader with volume, book and chapter navigation and context-aware linked names.

## Controls

- Volume chips (OT / NT / BoM), a dual-thumb window over twelve eras (Primeval to Nephite Twilight), seven role-group toggles, era playback, character search with disambiguators, focus mode, resizable reading panel.

## Data and method

- Text: the LDS Scriptures dataset (scriptures.nephi.org, 2020-12-08 edition), which publishes the text as public domain; preprocessed into per-book JSON.
- Characters, relationships, cross-references and chronology are hand-curated JSON datasets in `data/` (CC BY 4.0). Book of Mormon dating follows the text's internal year counts; Old World pre-monarchy dates are flagged as traditional.
- All client-side; no backend, no API keys.

## Plain pages (no JavaScript needed)

- https://curtishoffmann.com/scripture/books/ : all 86 books with full text, figures and cross-references
- https://curtishoffmann.com/scripture/people/ : 192 figures with disambiguators and every cited relationship
- https://curtishoffmann.com/scripture/cross-references/ : the 63 annotated links with commentary
- https://curtishoffmann.com/scripture/chronology/ : eras and dated events of both hemispheres
